about.title: The show
about.subtitle: One conversation a week with people who do the work — no lecture, no shortcut.
about.showText1: Onda started as a complaint: almost every interview about work stays on the surface. We wanted the boring part — how the decision was made, what it cost and what the person would do differently.
about.showText2: Three seasons, eight episodes each, recorded in the studio and published with chapters and a transcript. No guest returns just because the numbers were good.
about.hostsSubtitle: Two people in the booth, one question per episode.
about.sponsorSubtitle: Host-read insertions in pre, mid or post-roll. No programmatic ads.
about.faqSubtitle: What lands in our inbox the most.

faq.q1: How often does a new episode come out?
faq.a1: Every Thursday morning while a season runs. Between seasons we stop for a few months to record the next batch.
faq.a2: In any app that reads RSS. The feed is public and sits in the footer of this page; nothing is exclusive to one platform.
faq.a3: Everything published from season two on has a synced transcript. Clicking a line takes the player to that point.
faq.q4: How do I suggest a guest?
faq.a4: Write to the show email telling us who they are and which question you would like answered. Suggestions without a question usually go nowhere.
faq.q5: Can I use an excerpt in my own material?
faq.a5: Yes, crediting the show and the episode number. For commercial use, talk to us first.
faq.q6: Do you accept sponsorship from any company?
faq.a6: No. We turn down payday loans, betting and get-rich-quick courses, and we say it on air whenever the sponsor comes up in the conversation.
